response.sql: WITH currency_averages AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_currency_rebate FROM currency_averages) SELECT AVG(c.avg_rebate) AS mean_average_rebate, AVG(c.avg_relative_gap) AS mean_average_relative_gap, AVG(c.avg_rebate - b.avg_currency_rebate) AS mean_excess_rebate FROM currency_averages AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_rebate > b.avg_currency_rebate;
